viewing_check: Check motor plate (voltage, phase, runs freely by hand), any Ezycut maker's plate or model number, whether blade, guard, fence and buzzer cutter block are present and the table rise/fall and tilt move, bearing play, and rust pitting on table surfaces. Photograph the maker plate and motor plate.
